text.description_html:
Laurey 39306, Swirl Foundry Antique Pewter Cabinet Pull

The Foundry Antique Pewter Cabinet Pull is a rustic kitchen cabinet handle that is well suited to traditional Americana homes. The swirl design adds a point of interest to this 3 inch cabinet pull that also serves to highlight the beauty of the Antique Pewter finish. The Foundry Antique Pewter Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Foundry Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39306 3 Inch Foundry Pull in Antique Pewter:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Antique Pewter
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
